title: 第10章 第二案：水泥藏尸（3）
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【李警官，竟然是李警官？】

【不要啊！我可是李粉！李警官下线了，我看谁啊！】

【接下来的剧情应该是李警官去培训机构调查，结果撞上前来闹事的家长，不幸身亡。】

【散了吧，这期节目已经没啥看头了，我等下期节目再来。】

【导演，你是懂怎么刀人的，先给一颗糖，再给一巴掌是吧！】

“念念，吃糖吗？”

任曼妮撕开包装，熟练伸手递给对面。

可这次递过去的零食，却迟迟没有人接。

任曼妮奇怪，站起身看了一眼。

对面座位空空如也，哪里还有香香软软的小团子坐在凳子上，等她投喂！

Σ┗(＠ロ＠;)┛

任曼妮赶紧跑到门口询问。

结果门岗大爷恰好低头倒了杯水，没有看见念念出去。

好在警局监控不是吃素的。

任曼妮很快查到念念上了一辆出租车。

出租车离开的方向正是李安国走时的方向！

“叔叔！再快点！我赶着去救爸爸！”

出租车司机见她着急，也没多问。

一脚油门踩到底。

车速指针在超速边缘疯狂摇摆。

原本半小时才能到的路程，硬生生被他缩短了十几分钟。

出租车停下。

“小朋友，目的地到了，你爸爸呢？”

出租车司机没有听到回音，也没有听到有人下车。

疑惑抬头。

后视镜里。

念念正躲在后座下面，竖起一根手指，“嘘……”

小人儿直接被人拎了起来。

李安国扫码付钱。

等出租车走后，才将手里拎着的小人儿转了过来。

四目相对。

念念讨好，“爸，爸爸，好巧啊。”

激情褪去，剩下的只有后怕。

现在李安国好好的站在这，什么事都没有，那该有事的，就是她了！

“巧吗？”李安国冷哼，“你不是专门过来找我的吗？”

念念食指相对。

“如果我说我不来，你今天会死，你信吗？”

李安国气笑，“你说呢？”

Page (1/3)

[Officer Li, it’s actually Officer Li?】

【No!I'm a Li fan!Officer Li is offline, who am I looking at!】

[The next plot should be about Officer Li going to the training institution to investigate, but he bumped into a parent who came to make trouble and died unfortunately.】

[Let’s break up. There’s nothing interesting to watch in this episode. I’ll wait for the next episode.】

[Director, you know how to kill people, give them a candy first, then a slap, right?】

"Nian Nian, do you want to eat candy?"

Ren Manni tore open the package and skillfully handed it to the other side.

But this time, no one took the snacks that were handed over.

Ren Manni was surprised and stood up to take a look.

The seat opposite was empty, but there were fragrant and soft little dumplings sitting on the stool, waiting for her to feed them!

Σ┗(＠ロ＠;)┛

Ren Manni hurried to the door to ask.

As a result, Uncle Mengang just lowered his head to pour a glass of water and did not see Nian Nian go out.

Fortunately, police station surveillance is not a vegetarian.

Ren Manni quickly found out that Nian Nian got into a taxi.

The taxi left in the exact direction Li Anguo left!

"Uncle! Hurry up! I'm rushing to save dad!"

Seeing that she was anxious, the taxi driver didn't ask any questions.

Press the accelerator to the bottom.

The speed needle swung wildly on the edge of overspeeding.

The journey that originally took half an hour was shortened by ten minutes.

The taxi stopped.

"Kid, we've arrived at our destination, where is your father?"

The taxi driver heard no reply or anyone getting out of the car.

Doubt reared its head.

In the rearview mirror.

Niannian was hiding under the back seat, raising a finger, "Shh..."

The little man was picked up directly.

Li Anguo scanned the QR code to pay.

After the taxi left, he turned the little man in his hand around.

Eyes facing each other.

Nian Nian wanted to please, "Dad, Dad, what a coincidence."

The passion fades away, leaving only fear.

Now that Li Anguo is standing here properly and nothing happens, the one who should be in trouble is her!

"What a coincidence?" Li Anguo snorted coldly, "Didn't you come here specifically to find me?"

Nian Nian's index fingers face each other.

"If I said I didn't come, you would die today, would you believe it?"

Li Anguo laughed angrily, "What do you think?"
